info.title: Wallet & Ledger API
info.description:
Wallet and double-entry ledger API: wallet-to-wallet transfers, gateway deposits (ZarinPal) and transaction history.

- **Amounts** are integers in the currency's storage unit — rials for IRR. Never decimals, never tomans.
- **Authentication** is out of scope: send the authenticated user's id in the `X-User-Id` header (the provider callback is the one exception).
- **Idempotency**: `POST` operations require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Retrying with the same key and body returns the original outcome; the same key with a different body returns `409`.
- **Errors** share one shape: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "..."}}`; validation errors add a `fields` object.
- **Deposits** are credited only after the payment is verified server-to-server with the provider; a customer returning from the gateway is never proof of payment.

post.description:
Creates a pending deposit and asks the payment provider for a payment session.
Nothing is credited here: the client redirects the customer to `redirect_url`, and the
wallet is only credited after the customer returns and the payment is verified
server-to-server.

Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body returns the same result (the response
carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) and never creates a second deposit; the same key with
a different body returns 409. After a 503 (provider outcome unknown) retry with the same
key to resume the same deposit. After a 502 the deposit is failed and a new key is required.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the authenticated user. Authentication is out of scope, so this header stands in for it; a missing or unknown id returns 401.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key (max 128 printable ASCII characters), unique per user and operation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original outcome; the same key with a different payload returns 409.

403.description: - `forbidden`: You do not have access to this resource.

409.description:
- `idempotency_conflict`: The idempotency key was already used with a different request.
- `deposit_state_conflict`: The deposit is in a state that does not allow this operation.

422.description:
- `provider_disabled`: The payment provider is not available.
- `invalid_amount`: The amount is invalid.
- `currency_inactive`: The currency is not active.
- `currency_mismatch`: The currencies do not match.
- `validation_failed`: The request is invalid; `fields` maps each invalid field to its messages.

fields.description: Present for `validation_failed`: field name to list of messages.

502.description: - `provider_rejected`: The payment provider rejected the request.

503.description: - `provider_unavailable`: The payment provider is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.

get.description:
The browser redirect from the gateway. It carries no user header: the query string is
untrusted and only selects a stored deposit by its `Authority`. The payment is then verified
server-to-server using the amount stored at initiation, and the ledger transaction is posted
only after that. Nothing is ever created or credited from the query parameters alone.

`result` is derived from persisted state: `confirmed` (the ledger transaction committed),
`pending` (verification outcome not established yet; open the same URL again to retry),
`cancelled` (the provider reported cancellation, nothing credited) or `failed` (the provider
authoritatively rejected the payment). Revisiting the URL never credits twice.
get.summary: Customer return from the payment provider

409.description: - `deposit_state_conflict`: The deposit is in a state that does not allow this operation.

422.description: - `provider_disabled`: The payment provider is not available.

post.description:
Moves money between two wallets of the same currency. The debit, the credit, the two
ledger entries and the stored idempotency outcome commit atomically, or not at all.
Amounts are integers in the currency's storage unit (rials for IRR).

Retrying with the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body returns the original
response without moving money again (the response carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`);
the same key with a different body returns 409. Requests that fail validation are not
stored, so their key can be reused.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the authenticated user. Authentication is out of scope, so this header stands in for it; a missing or unknown id returns 401.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key (max 128 printable ASCII characters), unique per user and operation. Retrying with the same key and payload returns the original outcome; the same key with a different payload returns 409.

403.description: - `forbidden`: You do not have access to this resource.

409.description: - `idempotency_conflict`: The idempotency key was already used with a different request.

422.description:
- `insufficient_funds`: Insufficient funds in the sender wallet.
- `self_transfer`: Sender and recipient wallets must be different.
- `currency_mismatch`: The currencies do not match.
- `currency_inactive`: The currency is not active.
- `invalid_amount`: The amount is invalid.
- `validation_failed`: The request is invalid; `fields` maps each invalid field to its messages.

fields.description: Present for `validation_failed`: field name to list of messages.

get.description:
Posted transactions of one wallet, newest first (by transaction id), paginated with an opaque
cursor: pass the previous response's `next_cursor` as `cursor` to get the next page, until it
is `null`. Both wallets of a transfer see the same `reference`; `direction` is from the
requested wallet's point of view, and `counterparty_wallet_id` is `null` for deposits.
Pending and failed deposits are not transactions and are not listed.

Dates are ISO-8601 and normalized to UTC (a value without an offset is read as UTC);
`from` is inclusive and `to` is exclusive.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive (ISO-8601; read as UTC when no offset is given).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range, exclusive; it must be after `from`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Id of the authenticated user. Authentication is out of scope, so this header stands in for it; a missing or unknown id returns 401.

fields.description: Present for `validation_failed`: field name to list of messages.

wallet_id.description: Wallet to credit once the payment is verified; it must belong to the authenticated user.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's storage unit (rials for IRR), a positive integer up to the configured maximum.

provider.description: Name of an enabled payment provider. Defaults to the configured default provider.

from_wallet_id.description: Wallet to debit; it must belong to the authenticated user.

to_wallet_id.description: Wallet to credit; it must differ from the sender and use the same currency.
